notes: The Pratiharas had fallen; the Gahadavalas held Kannauj from c. 1089.
Sukhothai was founded in 1238; Lavo ruled central Thailand.
Added the crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem (1099).
Central Anatolia had fallen to the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum after Manzikert (1071).
Added the Danishmendid emirate in north-central Anatolia.
Bulgaria was a Byzantine province from 1018 to 1185.
The Mongols were still separate tribes (Kerait, Naiman, Tatar) until Temüjin.
Filled gaps in the source map from the nearest map (within 50 years).
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.
The Moche culture ended about 800; the north coast is the Sicán (Lambayeque) culture.
Lavo (Lopburi) was a small kingdom on the Chao Phraya, not the whole interior of mainland South-East Asia.
